items.title: 14.9 Link between air quality and human health

blocks.text: The link between air quality and human health is well documented and significant: poor air quality has immediate and long-term health impacts. The major pollutants and their effects are given in 14.9.1.

blocks.prompt: Why are the health effects of air pollution described as both immediate and long-term?
blocks.explanation: A day of high pollution can at once irritate eyes and airways and trigger asthma attacks, while years of breathing polluted air slowly cause chronic bronchitis, heart disease and cancer; both kinds of harm are measured in hospital admissions and death rates.

items: Poor air quality has immediate and long-term health effects.
